scope.purpose: W1 capacity truth and W2 require/project-manifest-v1 design

bank2_code_plane.booking_rule: gross headroom is shared by both fronts; only a product-shaped exact-meet proof may book bytes

c2d_v6.persistent_transient_meet: persistent entries plus active transient entries must be at most 2048; equality is legal

append_scratch.hard_floor: no C2D growth or journal write reaches 0xbd00

session_store.reason: runtime overlay storage is implementation machinery, not library payload capacity; avoided debits are not product credits
session_store.new_slice_rule: every new or enlarged carrier needs exact packing, catalog and per-slice proof; neither raw headroom number is a pre-authorization

resident_walls.rule: the first library/require implementation starts with zero resident debit; any measured debit is a separate Class-C question

first_probe_envelope.bank2_code_bytes: measured exact payload, bounded by the shared 30546-byte gross headroom
first_probe_envelope.c2d_rows: measured exact image/entry/resolution/root deltas under every independent hard cap
first_probe_envelope.c2d_scratch_bytes: measured exact export/journal demand under 14544 bytes
first_probe_envelope.heap_and_namepool: OPEN-measure-before-implementation; the seal exposes no honest free-byte claim for either
first_probe_envelope.failure_policy: reject before C2J ACTIVE or target mutation when any currency cannot close

parked_f3_example.disposition: semantic split required in a later freight round; no wall negotiation

surface.undefined_symbol_autoload: forbidden; diagnostics may only suggest an explicit require
surface.restart_repl: C2.3-only composition switch; v1 requires explicit loads in each fresh generation

project_manifest.name: L65P-v1
project_manifest.path_policy: relative media paths only; absolute paths, device prefixes, empty components and parent traversal are rejected
project_manifest.traditional_load: unchanged and fully supported without a project manifest

library_index.authority: one generated work-medium index, not copied require tables
row: artifact role and exact byte length
library_index.duplicates: two rows with one name are an ambiguity error
library_index.resolution_lock: load-project records the resolved name-to-identity rows before the first mutation; a future ship builder consumes the same source manifest plus this generated lock

preflight: resolve exactly one identity-bound index row
reject dependency cycles and missing dependencies
prove every independent W1 capacity currency with wide arithmetic
stage and authenticate the immutable library artifact
capture the complete dependency/identity plan before mutation
load: append through the existing C2-lite persistent transaction
copy and target-verify code in Bank 2
publish C2D and exports with READY/publish-last discipline
mark the exact library identity loaded for the current nonzero generation only after publication
require_transaction.idempotence_key: library identity plus current session generation
require_transaction.same_name_different_identity: fail closed; never silently replace a loaded library
require_transaction.graph_atomicity: each library append is atomic; dependencies already committed before a later failure remain loaded and valid
require_transaction.runtime_attic: forbidden; Attic may be a verified reconstructible cold cache, never an execution source
require_transaction.error_precedence: the innermost dependency or append status wins

order: strictly parse the sole L65P-v1 form
resolve and lock every require row
preflight aggregate capacities before the first append
run require entries in manifest order
load source files in manifest order
load_project.partial_failure: already committed libraries remain valid; the failing source is reported and later sources are not loaded
load_project.default_target: write-target authority only; it does not cause an implicit write
load_project.ship_builder_relation: v1 freezes the read-only composition surface; packaging/tree-shaking is later work and may not reinterpret the manifest

required_negative_fixtures: same name already loaded with another identity

halt_3_decision.random_note: lagged-Fibonacci baseline with xorshift option now enabled by F2 bitops

halt_3_questions: Accept the W1 nonfungible hard budgets and zero-resident first-probe rule?
Accept L65P-v1 as one unevaluated data form with name resolution through one identity-bound generated library index and a generated resolution lock?
Open the library era with a host-first require/index/preflight probe, while restart-repl, unload and ship packaging remain out of scope?
